wait_seconds.hint: Each new message resets this timer. Consecutive messages are merged with line breaks.

max_wait_seconds.hint: Only used when semantic checking decides that the message is incomplete.

semantic_check.description: Use an LLM to judge whether the message is complete
semantic_check.hint: Disabled by default to avoid an extra model request for every user turn.

semantic_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the current conversation provider.

semantic_min_chars.description: Minimum text length for semantic checking

semantic_extend_seconds.description: Extra wait after an incomplete result (seconds)
